title: Setup: build JUnit #6104 at both revisions and run its landed nested-class tests
description: Setup for case L05 of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-l01-l20-brief.md, no claims. In the setup checkouts under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20/worktrees (L05-junit-framework-fix = 2b484caa962ad9b0d9a6af5d2c25100b6a8f4ef6, L05-junit-framework-parent = bbeb7900fa76b6fc00e36e0bea05747066b4a2ec; standalone depth-1 clones, because JUnit's build reads git metadata), runs the upstream Gradle build through $O/scripts/L05-gradle.sh: Gradle 9.8.0 (zip checked against services.gradle.org and the wrapper's distributionSha256Sum) on JDK 25.0.5, toolchains JDK 17, 21, 24.0.2 and 25 from the caches, --no-build-cache and --no-scan, retries 0 and predictive test selection off. It builds the platform and Jupiter jars and runs org.junit.jupiter.engine.NestedTestClassesTests and ClassTemplateInvocationTests in jupiter-tests: on the fix online (first resolution of the test dependencies) then offline, on the parent its own copies offline, then the fix's two test classes and the changed testFixtures JupiterUniqueIdBuilder transplanted onto the parent (expected to fail, or not to compile; the step says which). The fix's jars took 4m18s online inline, which is why this is a job. Jars to .../artifacts, JUnit summaries to .../logs, checkouts restored and cleaned. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-l01-l20-brief-setup.md.
expected: every step exits 0: the fix's tests pass online and offline, the parent's own pass, the transplant prints TRANSPLANT-FAILS-AS-EXPECTED or TRANSPLANT-DOES-NOT-COMPILE, and the jars of both sides are copied

steps.name: L05 fix: jars, then jupiter-tests NestedTestClassesTests and ClassTemplateInvocationTests, online
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; source $HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20/scripts/env.sh; mkdir -p $O/tmp $O/logs $O/artifacts; cd $W/L05-junit-framework-fix; echo worktree=L05-junit-framework-fix commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD); rm -rf jupiter-tests/build/test-results/test; set +e; $O/scripts/L05-gradle.sh  -Ptesting.retries=0 -Pjunit.develocity.predictiveTestSelection.enabled=false :junit-jupiter-api:jar :junit-jupiter-engine:jar :junit-platform-commons:jar :junit-platform-engine:jar :junit-platform-launcher:jar :jupiter-tests:cleanTest :jupiter-tests:test --tests org.junit.jupiter.engine.NestedTestClassesTests --tests org.junit.jupiter.engine.ClassTemplateInvocationTests > $O/logs/L05-fix.test-online.gradle-log.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; set -e; echo gradle-exit=$rc; tail -8 $O/logs/L05-fix.test-online.gradle-log.txt; python3 -I $O/scripts/junit_summary.py jupiter-tests/build/test-results/test | tee $O/logs/L05-fix.test-online.junit.txt; test $(grep -o 'tests=[0-9]*' $O/logs/L05-fix.test-online.junit.txt | cut -d= -f2) -gt 0; test $(grep -o 'failures=[0-9]*' $O/logs/L05-fix.test-online.junit.txt | cut -d= -f2) -eq 0; test $(grep -o 'errors=[0-9]*' $O/logs/L05-fix.test-online.junit.txt | cut -d= -f2) -eq 0; echo PASS-CHECK-OK $O/logs/L05-fix.test-online.junit.txt; cp junit-jupiter-api/build/libs/junit-jupiter-api-6.2.0-SNAPSHOT.jar $O/artifacts/L05-junit-framework-fix-junit-jupiter-api.jar; cp junit-jupiter-engine/build/libs/junit-jupiter-engine-6.2.0-SNAPSHOT.jar $O/artifacts/L05-junit-framework-fix-junit-jupiter-engine.jar; cp junit-platform-commons/build/libs/junit-platform-commons-6.2.0-SNAPSHOT.jar $O/artifacts/L05-junit-framework-fix-junit-platform-commons.jar; cp junit-platform-engine/build/libs/junit-platform-engine-6.2.0-SNAPSHOT.jar $O/artifacts/L05-junit-framework-fix-junit-platform-engine.jar; cp junit-platform-launcher/build/libs/junit-platform-launcher-6.2.0-SNAPSHOT.jar $O/artifacts/L05-junit-framework-fix-junit-platform-launcher.jar; sha256sum $O/artifacts/L05-junit-framework-fix-*.jar;
